result.instructions: Tools for Estuary Flow, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Estuary Flow data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run estuary_flow_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run estuary_flow_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run estuary_flow_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. estuary_flow_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: estuary_list_catalog
tools.title: List catalog entities
tools.description: List live catalog entities (captures, collections, materializations, tests) the user can read, with connector + last-publication metadata. Optionally filter by a catalog-name prefix and spec_type. Estuary control-plane view live_specs_ext. PostgREST: GET /live_specs_ext.

name_prefix.description: Filter to catalog names starting with this prefix (PostgREST like.<prefix>* wildcard).

tools.name: estuary_get_catalog_spec
tools.title: Get catalog spec
tools.description: Get one live catalog entity by its exact catalog_name, including the full serialized `spec` and compiled `built_spec`. Estuary control-plane view live_specs_ext. PostgREST: GET /live_specs_ext?catalog_name=eq.<name>&limit=1.

tools.name: estuary_get_catalog_stats
tools.title: Get catalog stats
tools.description: Get usage/throughput stats for one catalog entity — bytes & docs read/written (both directions), usage_seconds, warnings/errors/failures, and txn_count — per time grain. Optionally bound by a timestamp range. Estuary control-plane view catalog_stats. PostgREST: GET /catalog_stats.

catalog_name.description: The exact catalog name to report stats for.

grain.description: Time grain of each stats row (default daily).

ts_start.description: Filter: stats at/after this ISO 8601 timestamp (ts gte).

ts_end.description: Filter: stats at/before this ISO 8601 timestamp (ts lte).

tools.name: estuary_list_connectors
tools.title: List connectors
tools.description: List the connector catalog — available capture/materialization Docker connectors, with titles, descriptions, and logos. Optionally filter to recommended connectors. Estuary control-plane table connectors. PostgREST: GET /connectors.

tools.name: estuary_list_connector_versions
tools.title: List connector versions
tools.description: List available versions (image tags) of connectors, with protocol and documentation URL. Optionally filter by connector_id. Estuary control-plane table connector_tags. PostgREST: GET /connector_tags.

tools.name: estuary_list_drafts
tools.title: List drafts
tools.description: List the user's draft workspaces (staging areas for catalog edits before publishing). Estuary control-plane table drafts. PostgREST: GET /drafts.

tools.name: estuary_list_draft_specs
tools.title: List draft specs
tools.description: List the staged spec entries within a draft (each an insert/replace of a catalog entity pending publication). Estuary control-plane table draft_specs. PostgREST: GET /draft_specs.

draft_id.description: The draft id to list staged specs for.

tools.name: estuary_list_publications
tools.title: List publications
tools.description: List publication history/status — each publish attempt of a draft; job_status carries the queued/success/failed outcome. Estuary control-plane table publications. PostgREST: GET /publications.

tools.name: estuary_list_discovers
tools.title: List discovers
tools.description: List connector discovery jobs (auto-detecting bindings/resources for a capture). Estuary control-plane table discovers. PostgREST: GET /discovers.

tools.name: estuary_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the roles/capabilities the current credential is granted — which catalog prefixes it can read/write/admin. Read-only RPC. Estuary control-plane: POST /rpc/auth_roles.

min_capability.description: Only return grants at/above this capability (default x_00 = all).

tools.name: estuary_get_tenant
tools.title: Get tenant
tools.description: Get the user's tenant(s) — quotas (tasks/collections), billing tiers, recurring charge, trial start, and payment provider. Estuary control-plane table tenants. PostgREST: GET /tenants.

tools.name: estuary_view_task_logs
tools.title: View task logs
tools.description: Fetch the log lines for a job by its logs_token (a UUID found on a publication, discover, or connector-tag record). Optionally page from a last-seen timestamp. Read-only RPC. Estuary control-plane: POST /rpc/view_logs.

bearer_token.description: The logs_token (UUID) from a publications/discovers/connector_tags row.

last_logged_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — return log lines after this point (2-arg view_logs overload).

tools.name: estuary_create_draft
tools.title: Create draft
tools.description: WRITE: create a new empty draft workspace (a staging area for catalog changes; does not affect live pipelines). Estuary control-plane: POST /drafts. Returns the created row.

detail.description: Optional human-readable note describing the draft's purpose.

tools.name: estuary_upsert_draft_spec
tools.title: Upsert draft spec
tools.description: WRITE: stage (insert or replace) a catalog spec inside a draft. Edits only the draft — live pipelines are unaffected until the draft is published. Estuary control-plane: POST /draft_specs (upsert on draft_id,catalog_name). Returns the staged row.

draft_id.description: The draft id to stage the spec into.

catalog_name.description: The catalog name of the entity being staged (e.g. acmeCo/inventory/products).

spec_type.description: The entity type of the staged spec.

spec.description: The catalog spec JSON object (passed through verbatim).

tools.name: estuary_publish_draft
tools.title: Publish draft
tools.description: WRITE (DESTRUCTIVE when dry_run=false): publish a draft. dry_run=true (default) only VALIDATES the draft without changing anything. dry_run=false APPLIES the draft to the LIVE catalog — this can create, modify, or DELETE running data pipelines and their data. Set dry_run=false only when you intend to change live infrastructure. Estuary control-plane: POST /publications. Returns the publication row.

dry_run.description: If true (DEFAULT), only validate without applying. Set false to APPLY to the live catalog.

detail.description: Optional human-readable note for this publication.
